reviewNote: 核查 Steam 英文商店页完整 AI 披露、身份（开发商 STIM GAMES）与英文讨论区首页（可见 1 个主题，总数 1），该主题与 AI 无关。本款单独检索公开报道 1 次、登记 3 条结果，读取 2 篇原始来源（AI Transparency Index 与 GameDB.ai 条目，均为商店披露的转录）。发售时间较短，未检索到独立媒体报道；除商店点名的角色与场景外，其余领域按未说明处理。结论基于开发者自述，未经独立审计。
disclosureQuote: Some characters and scenes in the game are generated by AI.
disclosureQuoteNote: Steam 商店 AI 生成内容披露栏完整原文，2026-10-30 核查；可能随商店页更新。

english.summary: A chibi-styled casual competitive typing game. The developer states that some characters and scenes in the game are generated by AI and says nothing about the other areas.
english.reviewNote: Reviewed the full English Steam AI disclosure, the identity (developer STIM GAMES) and the English discussion homepage (1 visible topic of 1), which is unrelated to AI. This title was searched once with 3 results logged and two raw sources read (AI Transparency Index and GameDB.ai, both transcriptions of the store disclosure). The game is newly released and no independent press coverage was found, so every area beyond the characters and scenes named by the store is recorded as not stated. Findings rely on developer statements, not an independent audit.
